This feed collects dated public lessons, Research articles, studies, benchmark reports, and approved glossary definitions in reverse chronological order.

Page publications must be explicitly marked `published: true` and supplied with a real publication date. Approved glossary definitions use their stable `Added` date and are inserted as individual feed items during the build. Landing pages, the 404 page, templates, drafts, hidden pages, planned content, and private fixtures are excluded.

::: {#updates}
:::
